paddock.title: mullet-paddock
paddock.blurb: Operator control center. React UI and FastAPI gateway. Discovers drones from heartbeats and drives semantic actions. No mock mode.
paddock.wires: Browser → gateway :8000 → ROS 2 action/service clients → mullet_interfaces → mullet_core. UI at :5173.

interfaces.title: mullet-interfaces
interfaces.blurb: Wire contract only: actions, heartbeat, mission API. No runtime. Change order: IDL → core populates → paddock reads.
interfaces.wires: Consumed by core, paddock (vendored), sitl_sim (submodule), and mission frameworks.

core.title: mullet-core
core.blurb: Soft real-time PX4 offboard supervisor. Owns takeoff, land, RTH, proof-of-life, and MissionCommand validation. PX4 stays hard RT. RC kill is the e-stop.
core.wires: Serves /<ns>/{takeoff,land,return_home} and /<ns>/{start_mission,hold}. Publishes /mullet/heartbeat. Talks PX4 on /fmu in|out.

commands.label: Aircraft
lines: cd docker && cp .env.example .env && docker compose up -d --build
ros2 action send_goal /uav_1/takeoff mullet_interfaces/action/Takeoff "{altitude_m: 2.0, yaw_rad: 0.0, use_current_yaw: true}" --feedback

ergodic.title: ergodic_mppi
ergodic.blurb: JAX potential-gradient MPPI as a MULLET mission framework. Loads ergodic/3 specs, streams MissionCommand. Never talks to /fmu/in/*.
ergodic.wires: paddock LoadMission → ergodic_mission → MissionCommand → mullet_core → PX4. Status on /mullet/mission_status.

commands.label: SITL
lines: docker run --rm --network host -e ROS_DOMAIN_ID=42 ergodic-mission:latest python /workspace/tests/sitl/sitl_e2e.py --drone uav_1

commands.label: Aircraft
lines: ssh orin 'cd ergodic_mppi/docker/mission && cp -n .env.example .env && docker compose up -d --build'
# DRONE_ID and ROS_DOMAIN_ID must match mullet_core

px4.title: PX4
px4.blurb: Hard real-time flight controller. Attitude, mixing, motors, failsafes. uXRCE-DDS to ROS 2. Emergency stop is the RC kill switch.
px4.wires: Pixhawk TELEM2 serial on the aircraft; UDP in SITL. Domain: UXRCE_DDS_DOM_ID = ROS_DOMAIN_ID.

ros_base.title: mullet_ros_base
ros_base.blurb: ARM64 ROS 2 Jazzy base for Jetson Orin (JetPack 6.2.2). CUDA 13.2 + compat, px4_msgs 1.17, Micro XRCE-DDS Agent v2.4.2. Pin v0.5.0+, never :main on aircraft.
ros_base.wires: FROM ghcr.io/skymule-ai/mullet-ros2-base:v0.5.0 — consumed by mullet-core and ergodic mission images.

commands.label: Orin
lines: MULLET_ROS_IMAGE_TAG=v0.5.0 docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.jetson.yml run --rm ros2-base

sitl_sim.title: mullet_sitl_sim
sitl_sim.blurb: Multi-vehicle PX4 SITL + Gazebo + ROS 2. One container, N vehicles, host tmux or headless. Live backend for paddock.
sitl_sim.wires: Image from sitl_builder. Submodules: mullet-core, mullet-interfaces. Headless paddock.yaml → uav_1 / uav_2 on domain 42.

sitl_builder.title: sitl_builder
sitl_builder.blurb: Builds the PX4 SITL Docker image: Ubuntu 24.04, ROS 2 Jazzy, Gazebo Harmonic, PX4 v1.17.0. No app logic.
sitl_builder.wires: Publishes ghcr.io/skymule-ai/px4-sitl:v1.17.0, consumed by mullet_sitl_sim. Keep lockstep with px4_msgs release/1.17.

commands.label: Build / pull
lines: git tag -a px4-v1.17.0 -m "Release PX4 v1.17.0" && git push origin px4-v1.17.0
